state.task: Two agents analysed Java code for path traversal (CWE-22). Their final answers follow, then the code of each method in question.
agent_answers: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Unpacker", "method": "process", "explanation": "The ZipUtil.Unpacker.process method directly uses attacker-controlled ZIP entry names from zipEntry.getName() to construct file paths via new File(outputDir, name) without any validation or sanitization.
